messages:
julia: Heads-up: planning an object-level re-encrypt for prod DB snapshots next Fri 02:00 UTC. Need to coordinate RBAC and audit so we don't lose original key provenance.
omar: Why object-level? Can't we rotate alias?
julia: Some customers use tenant CMKs; compliance requires objects be tied to the tenant key id. Alias flip isn't sufficient.
nina: Important: do a copy-to-new pattern, don't mutate metadata in-place. Add a signed_original_key field rather than overwriting.
omar: Also watch KMS grant pruning. We create ephemeral grants for uploader/restore during rotation; prune job could remove them and break restores.
nina: Proposal: extend grant TTL for rotation window and write grant-create audit events to the central index. Also emit snapshot.reencrypt.started/completed events with old/new key ids.
julia: Ops note: storage will spike ~1.4x during window. Can we keep both copies for 5 days before GC?
encops-bot: Runbook stub: https://encops.internal/runbooks/reencrypt-snapshots. Canary scheduled Fri 01:30 UTC to run full restore for three tenants.
julia: I'll open a playbook PR with copy-to-new, signed_original_meta, dual audit events, grant-ttl coordination, and a canary that simulates grant prune to validate failover.
